title: Zoom Slides
lede: Zoom Slides drafts editable presentations from a meeting's transcript or summary, as well as from prompts and documents, and keeps the deck inside Zoom for presenting and co-editing.

points: Zoom AI turns transcripts and meeting summaries into a structured draft with layouts, visuals and speaker notes.
Prompts and uploaded documents also work as starting points, and every slide stays editable.
PowerPoint files import and export, so a deck can move between Zoom and Office.
Decks can be presented in Zoom Meetings, edited live by several people and handed between speakers.
Voice Presentation reads the speaker notes aloud as AI narration for people who missed the meeting.

sections.text: People who spend much of the week in Zoom calls and then rebuild what was said into decks, such as account managers preparing a follow-up for a customer.
